name: tasknotes-nlp-core
description: Shared natural language parsing core for TaskNotes

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && git push origin main --follow-tags && npm publish
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && git push origin main --follow-tags && npm publish
scripts.release:major: npm version major && git push origin main --follow-tags && npm publish
